is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae collected in Mayotte (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for Vgsc L1014F (L995F), Vgsc L1014S (L995S), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) mutations in Anopheles gambiae (Page 4, 6, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports sample sizes and genotype counts for An. gambiae: L1014F (N=31, all susceptible homozygous), L1014S (N=28, all susceptible homozygous), and Ace-1 G119S (N=30, all susceptible homozygous) (Page 6, 7).

african_field_population.evidence: An. gambiae larvae collected from a garbage dump in Dzoumogné, Mayotte between 2010 and 2011 (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field study on mosquito insecticide resistance (Page 1-4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary field collection in Mayotte with no indication of sample overlap or reuse from external public datasets.

supplement.evidence: Extractable genotype counts and sample sizes for An. gambiae are fully presented in the main text.

assessment.summary: This primary study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance markers (Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae (and non-Anopheles species) collected in Dzoumogné, Mayotte in 2010-2011. An. gambiae specimens were fully susceptible to deltamethrin and harbored no Vgsc kdr or Ace-1 G119S mutations.
